phase_name: Establish the canonical no-task-references fragment and classification rule

objectives.description: Create canonical fragment file with the exact bullet text
Write in-scope classification rule into fragment header
Update rule file Enforcement section: replace Known gap paragraph
Register the new fragment in manifest.json provides array
objectives.note: No manifest.json edit made. Verified via lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/loader.lua (context category, entry_kind file_or_dir, lines ~435-459): a provides.context entry that resolves to a directory is copied recursively (scan_directory_recursive), so any new file placed inside an already-registered directory entry deploys automatically. manifest.json's provides.context already lists "contracts" as a directory entry (confirmed: jq -r '.provides.context[]' manifest.json includes 'contracts'), which is exactly how the two pre-existing files in that directory (phase-closure.md, pre-edit-gate.md) deploy today without their own manifest entries. Adding a manifest.json entry for the new fragment specifically would be a no-op at best and inconsistent with the existing precedent in the same directory.

deviations.description: Update agent-system/extensions/core/manifest.json to register the new fragment under the appropriate provides array so it deploys
deviations.reason: manifest.json's provides.context array already lists "contracts" as a whole-directory entry, which the deploy loader (loader.lua, file_or_dir entry kind) copies recursively. A new file placed inside context/contracts/ therefore deploys automatically without a new manifest.json entry -- verified against the loader source and against the precedent of the two pre-existing contracts/ files, neither of which has an individual manifest.json entry.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: skipped -- no manifest.json edit needed; the contracts/ directory entry already covers new files recursively, see progress file)*
